en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European town street. In the foreground is a wide, mostly empty road lined with young trees, simple fences, and a gas streetlamp. On the right are timber‑framed houses with steep roofs; two women in long dark dresses and head coverings stand on the sidewalk by a fence. In the middle distance are more small houses and gardens. Dominating the background is a large Gothic or late‑Gothic church with a high nave roof, buttresses, and a tall tower topped by an onion‑shaped spire. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century small town. No printed text is visible on the image side.
